admission.justification: The workflow instruction names the staged artifacts and the workspace definition keeps their directory private.

applicability: Explainer authoring for a recorded or planned binding.
conditions: The six private files name the binding and later stages read the earlier files.
The page assembles the evidence-bearing essay and its figures from the private stages.
exclusions: Retained drafts and revisions can predate a new authoring run.
The stage directory is outside the published and rendered content.

statement: The explainer writes six numbered intermediate artifacts in stages/ and produces drafts/assets/index.html as the seventh artifact.
